ps2.2:1.4: ‘Idaṃ dukkhan' ti Bhikkhave tathaṃ etaṃ avitathaṃ etaṃ anaññathaṃ etaṃ,
ps2.2:1.5: ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo' ti tathaṃ etaṃ avitathaṃ etaṃ anaññathaṃ etaṃ, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho' ti tathaṃ etaṃ avitathaṃ etaṃ anaññathaṃ etaṃ, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā' ti tathaṃ etaṃ avitathaṃ etaṃ anaññathaṃ etaṃ.
ps2.2:1.6: Imāni kho Bhikkhave cattāri tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni. Paṭis_II,II.2:
ps2.2:2.2: Cattāro dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā;
ps2.2:2.4: Ime cattāro dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.
ps2.2:3.2: Cattāro samudayassa samudayaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā;
ps2.2:3.4: Ime cattāro samudayassa samudayaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.
ps2.2:4.2: Cattāro nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā:
ps2.2:4.4: Ime cattāro nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.
ps2.2:5.2: Cattāro maggassa maggaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā:
ps2.2:5.4: Ime cattāro maggassa maggaṭṭhā tathā avitathā anaññathā.
ps2.2:6.1: Paṭis_II,II.3: Katih' ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni?
ps2.2:6.4: Imehi catūh' ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:7.2: Catūh' ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni;
ps2.2:7.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,maggassa maggaṭṭho tathaṭṭho.
ps2.2:7.4: Imehi catūh' ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:8.2: Catūh' ākārehi anattaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:8.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho anattaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho anattaṭṭho.
ps2.2:8.4: Imehi catūh' ākārehi anattaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:9.2: Catūh' ākārehi saccaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:9.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho saccaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho saccaṭṭho.
ps2.2:9.4: Imehi catūh' ākārehi saccaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:10.2: Catūh' ākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:10.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho.
ps2.2:10.4: Imehi catūh' ākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni. ‘Yaṃ ekasaṅgahitaṃ , taṃ ekattaṃ;
ps2.2:11.2: Yaṃ aniccaṃ, taṃ dukkhaṃ; yaṃ aniccañ ca dukkhañ ca, taṃ anattā;
ps2.2:11.3: yaṃ aniccañ ca dukkhañ ca anattā ca, taṃ tathaṃ;
ps2.2:11.4: yaṃ aniccañ ca dukkhañ ca anattā ca tathañ ca, taṃ saccaṃ;
ps2.2:11.5: yaṃ aniccañ ca dukkhañ ca anattā ca tathañ ca saccañ ca, taṃ ekasaṅgahitaṃ.
ps2.2:12.3: tathaṭṭhena anattaṭṭhena saccaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena abhiññaṭṭhena pariññaṭṭhena pahānaṭṭhena bhāvanaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena.
ps2.2:12.4: Imehi navah' ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:13.2: Navah' ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:13.3: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, pariññāya pariññaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, pahānassa pahānaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, bhāvanāya bhāvanaṭṭho tathaṭṭho, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho tathaṭṭho.
ps2.2:13.4: Imehi navah' ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:14.4: Navah' ākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:14.5: dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, samudayassa samudayaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, nirodhassa nirodhaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, maggassa maggaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, pariññāya pariññaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, pahānassa pahānaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, bhāvanāya bhāvanaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho paṭivedhaṭṭho.
ps2.2:14.6: Imehi navah' ākārehi paṭivedhaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:15.1: Katih' ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni? Dvādasahi
ps2.2:15.3: tathaṭṭhena anattaṭṭhena saccaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena abhijānanaṭṭhena parijānanaṭṭhena dhammaṭṭhena tathaṭṭhena ñātaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena.
ps2.2:15.4: Imehi dvādasahi ākārehi cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:16.1: Kathaṃ tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni? Soḷasahi
ps2.2:16.3: dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho saṅkhataṭṭho santāpaṭṭho vipariṇāmaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.4: samudayassa āyuhanaṭṭho nidānaṭṭho saññogaṭṭho palibodhaṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.5: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho vivekaṭṭho asaṅkhataṭṭho amataṭṭho tathaṭṭho,
ps2.2:16.6: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho hetuṭṭho dassanaṭṭho ādhipateyyaṭṭho tathaṭṭho.
ps2.2:16.7: Imehi soḷasahi ākārehi tathaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:17.12: Soḷasahi ākārehi abhisamayaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekapaṭivedhāni:
ps2.2:17.13: dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭho saṅkhataṭṭho santāpaṭṭho vipariṇāmaṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho,
ps2.2:17.14: samudayassa āyuhanaṭṭho nidānaṭṭho saññogaṭṭho palibodhaṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho,
ps2.2:17.15: nirodhassa nissaraṇaṭṭho vivekaṭṭho asaṅkhataṭṭho amataṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho,
ps2.2:17.16: maggassa niyyānaṭṭho hetuṭṭho dassanaṭṭho ādhipateyyaṭṭho abhisamayaṭṭho.
ps2.2:17.17: Imehi soḷasahi ākārehi abhisamayaṭṭhena cattāri saccāni ekasaṅgahitāni.
ps2.2:19.3: saṅkhatānaṃ saccānaṃ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyati; asaṅkhatassa saccassa na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, va ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:20.3: dukkhasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati;
ps2.2:20.4: samudayasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati;
ps2.2:20.5: maggasaccassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati;
ps2.2:20.6: nirodhasaccassa na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, na ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
ps2.2:21.1: Catunnaṃ saccānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati abyākatā?
ps2.2:21.2: Samudayasaccaṃ akusalaṃ, maggasaccaṃ kusalaṃ, nirodhasaccaṃ abyākataṃ,
ps2.2:21.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kusalaṃ siyā akusalaṃ siyā abyākataṃ.
ps2.2:22.1: Tīṇi saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekaṃ saccaṃ tīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ
ps2.2:22.5: evaṃ akusalaṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni: ekasaccaṃ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ.
ps2.2:22.7: evaṃ kusalaṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni: ekaṃ saccaṃ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ.
ps2.2:22.9: evaṃ abyākataṭṭhena dve saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni: ekasaccaṃ dvīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ.
ps2.2:22.10: Evaṃ siyā. Tīṇi saccāni ekasaccena saṅgahitāni, ekasaccaṃ tīhi saccehi saṅgahitaṃ vatthuvasena pariyāyenāti. Paṭis_II,II.9:
ps2.2:23.1: Pubbe me Bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa Bodhisattass' eva sato etad ahosi --
ps2.2:23.2: ‘Ko nu kho rūpassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
ps2.2:23.3: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
ps2.2:23.4: Ko saññāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
ps2.2:23.5: Ko saṅkhārāṇaṃ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?
ps2.2:23.6: Ko viññāṇassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇan' ti?
ps2.2:23.8: ‘Yaṃ kho rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ,
ps2.2:23.17: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ,
ps2.2:24.1: Paṭis_II,II.10: Yāva kīvañ cāhaṃ Bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nabbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ Bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamanabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ. Yato ca khvāhaṃ Bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ Bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
ps2.2:24.2: Ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi
ps2.2:24.4: ayaṃ antimā jāti, natth' idāni punabbhavo' ti. Paṭis_II,II.11:
ps2.2:25.1: ‘Yaṃ rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa assādo' ti
ps2.2:25.3: ‘yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo' ti
ps2.2:25.5: ‘yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇan' ti
ps2.2:25.7: yā imesu tīsu ṭhānesu diṭṭhi saṅkappo vācā kammanto ājīvo vāyāmo sati samādhi
ps2.2:26.4: yaṃ viññāṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ viññāṇassa assādo' ti
ps2.2:26.6: ‘yaṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavo' ti
ps2.2:26.8: ‘yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇan' ti
ps2.2:26.10: yā imesu tīsu ṭhānesu diṭṭhi saṅkappo vācā kammanto ājīvo vāyāmo sati samādhi
ps2.2:27.1: Paṭis_II,II.12: ‘Saccan' ti. Katih' ākārehi saccaṃ? Tīh' ākārehi saccaṃ:
ps2.2:27.8: Jarāmaraṇañ ca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇasamudayañ ca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhañ ca pajānāti, jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:28.5: Jātiñ ca pajānāti, jātisamudayañ ca pajānāti, jātinirodhañ ca pajānāti, jātinirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:29.5: Bhavañ ca pajānāti, bhavasamudayañ ca pajānāti, bhavanirodhañ ca pajānāti, bhavanirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:30.5: Upādānañ ca pajānāti, upādānasamudayañ ca pajānāti, upādānanirodhañ ca pajānāti, upādānanirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:31.5: Taṇhañ ca pajānāti, taṇhāsamudayañ ca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhañ ca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:32.5: Vedanañ ca pajānāti, vedanāsamudayañ ca pajānāti, vedanānirodhañ ca pajānāti, vedanānirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:33.5: Phassañ ca pajānāti, phassasamudayañ ca pajānāti, phassanirodhañ ca pajānāti, phassanirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:34.5: saḷāyatanañ ca pajānāti, saḷāyatanasamudayañ ca pajānāti, saḷāyatananirodhañ ca pajānāti, saḷāyatananirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:35.3: Nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññānajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavan' ti
ps2.2:35.5: Nāmarūpañ ca pajānāti, nāmarūpasamudayañ ca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhañ ca pajānāti, nāmarūpanirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:36.5: Viññāṇañ ca pajānāti, viññāṇasamudayañ ca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhañ ca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:37.5: Saṅkhāre ca pajānāti, saṅkhārasamudayañ ca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhañ ca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhagāminipaṭipadañ ca pajānāti.
ps2.2:38.1: Jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, jāti samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.2: jāti dukkhasaccaṃ, bhavo samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.3: bhavo dukkhasaccaṃ, upādānaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.4: upādānaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, taṇhā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.5: taṇhā dukkhasaccaṃ, vedanā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.6: vedanā dukkhasaccaṃ, phasso samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.7: phasso dukkhasaccaṃ, saḷāyatanaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.8: saḷāyatanaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, nāmarūpaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.9: nāmarūpaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, viññāṇaṃ samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.10: viññāṇaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, saṅkhārā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:38.11: saṅkhārā dukkhasaccaṃ, avijjā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ.
ps2.2:39.1: Jarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, jāti siyā dukkhasaccaṃ siyā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ;
ps2.2:39.2: jāti dukkhasaccaṃ, bhavo siyā dukkhasaccaṃ siyā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccaṃ; . . . pe . . .
ps2.2:39.3: saṅkhārā dukkhasaccaṃ, avijjā siyā dukkhasaccaṃ siyā samudayasaccaṃ, ubhinnaṃ pi nissaraṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhapajānanā maggasaccan ti.
